description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark with Stacking]/[Attach Fire with Stacking] based on entry element damage, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode] and [Crystal Force Mode: Jecht] to the user

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Jecht
description.text: Dark/Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark and Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode
